o.text: Borrowed from Arabic طَلَبَة (ṭalaba), plural of طَالِب (ṭālib, “seeker, pursuer; student, scholar”).

glosses: gift sent to the household of the fiancée as a token of engagement (usually a ring and a headscarf)
k.o. plant used to produce dyes

o.text: Derivation from Proto-Turkic *bel-. Some senses may actually belong under Etymology 2, and vice-versa.
From görüldü (“seen (in messaging)”) + atmaq (“to throw, to send, to leave”). Calque of Turkish görüldü atmak.
Izafet compound of gövhər (“gem”) + laməkan (“placeless”), ultimately from Classical Persian گوهر and Arabic لامکان.
